John must give in to the demands of a blackmailer to prevent him from goading Buck into a no-win gun battle.
Pop Keith prepares to be hanged.
Bret sets out to capture two thieves after an entire poker game is robbed.
Miss Kitty attempts to keep a young boy from his father, who is a fugitive and a killer.
A strict father, who thinks one of his own sons should hang for committing a murder, blames the wrong boy.

Covington travels to Wyoming with his friends, Rock Mullaney (David O'Hara) and J.T. Langston (Christian Kane), where he tells Anne of her husband's death. Matt Dillon steps in to stop outlaws who have attacked a prospector whose life savings are stashed on his property.
No one believes an over-imaginative boy who stumbles upon the secluded shack of a highwayman and his accomplice wife.
When the horses on the wagon train suddenly begin dying, Flint is sent to find a doctor and finds himself in a shootout with the man's son-in-law.
A vegetarian's (David Wayne) crusade to convert the beef-eating town of Medicine Bow makes locals consider him insane; guests Barbara Barrie, Morgan Woodward.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
Cheyenne faces an angry town and a dangerous gunman to save the life of an old friend.

Elderly John Jones is the only person kidnapped from a Wells Fargo stage.

Heath suspects a woman who has come to wed her longtime pen pal, a homely, middle-aged farmer.
When he kills the sheriff chasing him, an outlaw switches identities with the dead man and tries to fool Slim and Jess.
Cheyenne teams up with an ex-gunslinger to deliver thousands of dollars to the widow of the man he killed years earlier.
Mark meets a stranger whom Lucas suspects of being a wanted man.
A young man wants an education despite his uncle's objection.

With an increase of Sioux attacks on the stage, Slim suggests repairing an old road as an alternate route.
While panning gold, Morgan Trude shoots Cheyenne, thinking he is going to rob him.
A forensic anthropologist is brought to a gunman's cabin for scientific research. Starring Richard Boone and Roy Barcroft.
Paladin helps a Mexican revolutionary general recover French bonds which were removed from Mexico by Emperor Maximilian's supporters.
Chester is taken prisoner after his horse is injured while he is out looking for Doc Adams.

Newly allies himself with his prisoner, a hired killer, to escape bounty hunters and return to Dodge City.
